GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2019-08-05T20:47:57Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Using runningDifference() and quantilesExactWeighted() correctly on time series data
Description: We need to calculate exact value quantiles on large non-uniformly sampled time series data. The schema is (String sensor_path, DateTime timestamp, Float64 value). 

It would be perfect if we could use something like „SELECT quantilesExactWeighted(...)(value, delta)...“,
where „delta“ is the result of „runningDifference(timestamp)“. 
Unfortunately, this does not work, because for each row, delta is the time difference between the previous and the current row instead of the time difference between the current and the next row, as needed for the weights parameter of quantilesExactWeighted(). 

Self-joining the time series to shift delta forward one row will probably not work when the time series does not fit into memory, right?

Is there maybe another, more efficient solution?

I’d be glad to try to submit a patch with a new variant of runningDifference() if there is no other solution. 

Many thanks for your excellent work on ClickHouse!
